newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent rally on Iraq news curbed by sellers.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent rally on Iraq news curbed by sellers.

text.p: IPE Brent crude rallied 10 cents briefly on a bullish report about Iraqi oil exports but a wave of selling took it swiftly back down, brokers said.
August Brent was trading down 23 cents at $17.85 a barrel at 1602 GMT, after rising 10 cents to $17.88 on the Iraq news. Gas oil was trading down -$4.50 a tonne.
"It rallied pretty well on the Iraq report but a wave of selling came in fast," one broker said.
In New York, an Iraqi official at the United Nations said oil sales under the U.N. "oil-for-food" deal would not begin until the money currently held in an escrow account was spent.
